graphics.title: Graphics

hint.windows: Change it in Settings → Accessibility → Visual effects → Animation effects.
hint.macos: Change it in System Settings → Accessibility → Display → Reduce motion.
hint.ios: Change it in Settings → Accessibility → Motion → Reduce Motion.
hint.android: Change it in Settings → Accessibility → Remove animations.
hint.other: Change it in your device’s accessibility settings.
